### 2026-10-18 – Just spent more than 4 hours resolving errors, first the components kept intersecting causing the grippers to not even come close to each other much less close. To resolve this I changed the length of

**4.5h**

Just spent more than 4 hours resolving errors, first the components kept intersecting causing the grippers to not even come close to each other much less close. To resolve this I changed the length of the bar moved the holes where the bars were joint and nothing seemed to help. The error was that one of the components was a body of another component and both moved together , hence stopping movement. After resolving this there was another problem that one component that I copy pasted and deleted original was causing problems so I deleted that copied one and made a new one from scratch. Then another problem arose where the components stopped moving altogether.  It took me time to resolve this too. The revolution limits were not set properly...😵‍💫😵‍💫😵‍💫
After this I made motion link so the grippers open and close together..
